processGroups.comments: The batch waits for 20,000 orders but its input connection holds only 10,000, so it empties only at its 30 minute bin age and the back pressure reaches ingest. (symptom: backpressure)
processGroups.name: S22 Order Merge Deadlock

processGroups.comments: The carrier throttle allows 600 shipments a minute (10/s) against 30/s coming in. (symptom: throughput)
processGroups.name: S23 Throttled Fulfilment
